tools.name: get_studio_info
tools.description: Fetch studio profile, background, focus areas, contact info, and social links -> {name, tagline, description, focus_areas, contact_email, sister_company, social_links}

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Fetch detailed case study information for a specific portfolio project (params: id — slug/URL/name, defaults to first work; navigate=false) -> {id, title, overview, paragraphs, video_urls, url}

id.description: Work slug (e.g., 'cartier', 'max-mara-art-price-for-women') or full URL. Defaults to the first project.

navigate.description: If true, navigates the browser to the project page.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List selected client brands and luxury partners the studio has worked with -> {count, clients: list [string]}

tools.name: list_works
tools.description: List or filter portfolio projects and case studies (params: category, query, navigate=false) -> {count, works: list [{id, title, category, year, summary, url}]}

query.description: Filter by keyword in project title or summary.

navigate.description: If true, navigates the browser to the first matching project page.

tools.name: start_inquiry
tools.description: Populate the contact form and scroll into view for user review, or submit inquiry (params: name, email, message, submit=false) -> {status, recipient, data|current_values, contact_email}

submit.description: If true, submits the contact form. Defaults to false (prepare and hand off).
